races.paceDynamic: Monntie and Manoir De Mirande will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both horses having confirmed front-running tendencies. With 19 runners and these two pace angles committed early, the tempo will be honest throughout the 2m1f trip. The sustained pace will stretch the field and create opportunities for those who can travel and finish, while potentially finding out the stamina reserves of the early leaders. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can come with late runs, as the early pace will set up perfectly for closers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Monntie and Manoir De Mirande go hard from the flag and maintain a searching gallop
scenarios.body: The honest tempo will suit horses with proven finishing kicks who can sit off the pace and come home strongly. Ole Ole and Try Them are perfectly positioned to capitalize on this scenario with their tactical speed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Contested Lead
scenarios.trigger: If the two front-runners settle into a more measured rhythm after the initial exchanges
scenarios.body: This allows the prominent racers to stay closer to the pace without being stretched early, giving them every chance to outstay the leaders. Whats New and Littlebeen can use their proven tactical pace to great effect.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If either Monntie or Manoir De Mirande gets an uncontested lead and controls the fractions
scenarios.body: A soft lead could prove decisive on this good to soft ground, allowing the leader to save energy for a sustained finish. The Gordon Elliott-trained Manoir De Mirande looks the most likely to execute this plan with Jack Kennedy aboard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners fail to fire early or get into a speed duel that compromises them both
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where those closest to the pace can strike, favouring horses with natural early speed. This scenario opens up opportunities for the more unfancied prominent types to capitalize on the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Manoir De Mirande and Monntie must be watched early to see if they engage in a pace duel that could compromise both
Ole Ole's jumping needs monitoring as any mistake could derail chances given the likely strong gallop
Try Them's position turning for home will be crucial given hold-up style and tendency to need late room
Several lightly raced types including Messire Des Bordes could outrun odds if adapting immediately to hurdles
Ground conditions may deteriorate further given yielding reports across all races, favouring proven soft ground performers

races.paceDynamic: Grandy Lane and Sticktothescript will contest the early lead, with Grandy Lane showing more pace on recent form while Sticktothescript brings reliable front-running tactics. Following Orders and Two Pair will track prominently, creating a solid gallop that should stretch the field. The large field of 19 runners with numerous hold-up horses suggests congestion at the back, while the confirmed pace angle up front will create a searching test. This race shape strongly favours prominent trackers who can avoid the scramble behind while capitalising on the strong gallop set by the front two.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Grandy Lane and Sticktothescript maintain honest pace throughout
scenarios.body: The strong gallop stretches the field and exposes the hold-up horses caught in traffic. Following Orders and Two Pair are perfectly positioned to strike from their tracking positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runners Battle
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders maintain their duel into the straight
scenarios.body: Grandy Lane's recent form edge over Sticktothescript proves decisive in a prolonged battle. The pace becomes unsustainable for the rest of the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses and the leaders come back dramatically
scenarios.body: The large field creates a muddling pace that allows the back markers to close late. Kasper Hauser and Glenrush Bay benefit from the sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or interference disrupts the race flow
scenarios.body: The 2m1f trip with inexperienced hurdlers creates carnage that favours horses with clear runs. Maxwell Smart's previous win gives him an edge in messy conditions.

watchPoints.text: Grandy Lane and Sticktothescript must both jump cleanly early or the pace scenario collapses completely

races.paceDynamic: Disco Dancer appears the sole committed front-runner, with Theflyingbee, Patty O'Farrell, Eastern Wind, Mo Ghille Mar and Fedneys Park all capable of racing prominently but not necessarily needing the lead. This sets up a moderate pace where Disco Dancer can dictate terms without pressure, allowing the prominent racers to settle comfortably behind. The large contingent of hold-up horses (Fiver Friday, Simple Things, Fortunate Lighting, Cleopatra's Needle) will rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. The controlled pace and lack of early pressure clearly favours prominent racers who can track the leader and have first run on the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Disco Dancer sets a steady pace with prominent runners tracking smoothly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Theflyingbee, Patty O'Farrell and Eastern Wind to position perfectly and get first run on the closers. Hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Disco Dancer faces no early challenge and can dictate completely
scenarios.body: The experienced front-runner uses tactical pace control to see off prominent challengers, while hold-up horses again struggle with insufficient early gallop. Disco Dancer's class tells under these ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses go faster than expected trying to pressure Disco Dancer
scenarios.body: The increased pace sets up perfectly for Fiver Friday or Cleopatra's Needle to deliver their trademark finishing kicks. Simple Things and Fortunate Lighting also benefit from the stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent horses sit too close and none commits to racing
scenarios.body: The crawling pace becomes a sprint finish where any horse can win regardless of running style. Form and class become less relevant than position and luck in running.

watchPoints.text: Theflyingbee's 83-day absence could leave her short of peak fitness despite strong historical form at these conditions
Fiver Friday and Fortunate Lighting both face fitness concerns after long breaks that could blunt their crucial finishing kicks
Eastern Wind's 173-day layoff is the longest in the field and represents significant risk for any prominent runner
Watch for Disco Dancer getting too easy a lead early as Jack Kennedy may be able to control the race completely
Simple Things is the youngest horse at four and could be vulnerable to more experienced mares in a tactical finish

races.paceDynamic: Marlpark and Blue Reed are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early lead, with both needing to go forward from the break. This dual pace angle should create an honest gallop throughout, particularly with 13 runners ensuring no hiding place. The tempo will be solid but not suicidal, as both leaders have stamina for the trip, setting up a race where horses can track and challenge from off the pace. This pace scenario clearly favours prominent trackers and hold-up horses who can benefit from the strong gallop and finish off the bridle.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark and Blue Reed duel early but maintain reasonable fractions
scenarios.body: The honest pace allows prominent runners to sit in perfect striking positions before unleashing late kicks. Horses like Something Noble and Syracus Du Houx can track the pace without being compromised and have first run on the tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves strong enough to set up a closer
scenarios.body: The solid gallop creates perfect conditions for patient tactics to pay dividends. Dairy Force or Tsavo Park can be produced with withering late runs to collar horses who've done too much work earlier.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Marlpark or Blue Reed gets soft fractions after early skirmishing
scenarios.body: The leader manages the pace cleverly after seeing off their rival and has enough left to resist late challenges. Blue Reed's low weight makes him particularly dangerous if getting loose on the lead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders compromise each other badly in protracted early battle
scenarios.body: The tempo becomes stop-start which negates stamina advantages and turns it into a sprint finish. This random outcome could suit any horse getting the right racing room in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Blue Reed could get loose on the lead if Marlpark fails to go with him early, creating a potentially unassailable advantage
Something Noble's 25-1 shock win last month means he could be ahead of his handicap mark if continuing to improve
Dairy Force represents the Elliott-Kennedy combination in excellent current form and drops back to optimal trip
The going has been called yielding consistently throughout the card which may disadvantage any horse wanting faster conditions
Several horses carry claiming riders whose weight allowances could prove decisive in tight handicap finish

races.paceDynamic: Concert Party stands as the sole confirmed front-runner in this 19-runner handicap hurdle, giving him complete control over the early gallop without pressure. Krishna Bellevue and Harley Street can press from prominent positions, but both carry fade-in-finish warnings that suggest they'll struggle to sustain pressure. The massive field of 16+ hold-up horses will create a cavalry charge scenario in the final furlong, with the pace likely collapsing as Concert Party tires and the back markers unleash their finishing kicks. This race shape heavily favours strong-finishing hold-up horses who can produce sustained runs from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Stampede
scenarios.trigger: If Concert Party sets manageable fractions and the prominent horses fade as expected
scenarios.body: The lone leader will weaken turning for home, creating a perfect setup for the army of hold-up horses to unleash finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Strong stayers with tactical speed will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Concert Party gets very soft fractions and kicks clear before the hold-up horses can organize
scenarios.body: With so many hold-up horses relying on each other for pace, Concert Party could build an unassailable lead if the jockeys hesitate too long behind him. His 2W2P record on similar going shows he can sustain a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Krishna Bellevue or Harley Street press Concert Party too hard in the middle stages
scenarios.body: All three pace angles could empty out simultaneously, leaving the race wide open for any hold-up horse with a clean run and finishing kick. The 19-runner field will create traffic problems that could eliminate several chances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Benefits Closer
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Concert Party earlier than expected, creating genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: Strong early gallop will set up a true staying test that suits the most genuine stayers among the hold-up brigade. Late-running horses with proven stamina will have the tactical advantage.

watchPoints.text: Concert Party must be watched for early pace - if he gets soft fractions uncontested, he could steal a march on the 16 hold-up horses behind him
Krishna Bellevue and Harley Street both carry fade-in-finish warnings but will be prominently placed early, creating false pace impressions
Tropical Twist represents the in-form Elliott stable with only 28 days since his last run, giving him a significant fitness edge in this field
The 19-runner field will create traffic problems turning for home, making jockey positioning crucial for the army of hold-up horses
Multiple horses returning from 100+ day breaks including Pourquoi Poi (149d) and Struck Oil (149d) face serious fitness tests in large competitive field

races.paceDynamic: Insouciant Dallier will dictate from the front with Money Heist, Clonbury Bridge and Dinoland tracking closely in the early stages. With only one confirmed front runner and several prominent racers content to sit second, the pace will be measured rather than fierce through the early circuits. The large field of hold-up horses including Priory Park, Glenmalure Lady and Its Not Over Yet will create congestion in behind, but the lack of early pace pressure means they'll have time to organize. This sustainable tempo strongly favours the prominent racers who can position handy without being hard-used early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Measured Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Insouciant Dallier maintains a steady gallop without serious challenge until the straight
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get the perfect trip tracking the leader comfortably, then have enough left to resist the late charge from the hold-up brigade. Those positioned second or third early can time their runs perfectly in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the field bunches approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the perfect setup with plenty of horse left for a sustained finish, overwhelming the prominent racers who've been niggled along from halfway. Fresh finishers come from last to first in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If Insouciant Dallier gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to close quickly enough
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage in the straight while the field argues behind, with only the handiest prominent racers able to get close. The hold-up horses have too much ground to make up despite the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes crawling and turns into a sprint from the last mile
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of finishing speed rather than stamina, suiting the freshest hold-up horses with the best turn of foot. Prominent racers get swamped by superior finishing kicks despite better positions.

watchPoints.text: Insouciant Dallier's early sectionals - if she goes too fast early she'll crack completely in the straight
Traffic problems in the back half with 15+ hold-up horses all needing room at the same time approaching the straight
Money Heist and Clonbury Bridge positioning behind the leader - whoever sits closer will have the tactical advantage
Ground conditions deteriorating through the card - later runners may face significantly softer conditions than advertised
Amateur jockey handling in the closing stages with multiple 7lb claimers under pressure for the first time at this level

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Auction (Pro/Am) INH Flat Race (IRE Incentive Race)
